intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: An official-looking sheet drifts by. Nerelle fishes it out and reads it, dripping.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “A surface office has issued a permit for pleasant weather. It has a seal.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Does the sea council do anything like that?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “We issue warnings, not commands to clouds. It saves embarrassment.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A single fat raindrop lands on the seal.

options.labelText: “Want to stamp it ‘Declined by the clouds’ and send it back?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Yes. I carry waterproof ink for exactly this.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She writes *Declined by the clouds* across the seal, in a hand much neater than the office’s.

options.labelText: “Your council should try one. A permit for one nice day can’t hurt.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “And when the permitted day rains, whom do they blame?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I have no wish to become personally responsible for thunder.”
